alternatives.reason_rejected: Native build step adds npx cold-start failure modes on machines without toolchains.
Drops Node 18/20 users for an opt-in feature; belongs to the v2.0 release.

context: node:sqlite needs Node >= 22.13 but the CI matrix and installed base include 18/20; the plan wants the backend baking in the field before the v2 default flip.
rationale: Zero native dependencies matter for an npx-launched server (this sandbox's proxy blocking onnxruntime's postinstall download proved the failure mode); opt-in with graceful fallback lets 18/20 users stay untouched until v2 bumps engines.
summary: Ship the SQLite backend opt-in (storage.backend config, warn-and-fallback) on node:sqlite instead of bumping engines or adding better-sqlite3
